welcome:
*Welcome to {fest_name} Registration*

Please select your registration category:
*1* — Host College Student ({host_college})
*2* — External College Student (All Other Colleges)

Reply with *1* or *2*.
invalid_choice: ⚠️ Invalid option. Please reply with *1* or *2* to continue.
invalid_name: ⚠️ Please enter your valid Full Name (at least 2 letters):
invalid_roll: ⚠️ Please enter a valid College Roll Number / Registration ID:
ask_roll: Enter your *College Roll Number* / Registration ID:
ask_dept: Enter your *Department / Branch* (e.g. CSE, ECE, Mech):
event_sold_out:
⚠️ *{event_name} is SOLD OUT*

The physical slot capacity ({slot_limit} participants) has been reached. Please reply with another event number to choose a different track.
ask_team_name:
🏆 *Team Event Selected: {event_name}*
Maximum Team Size: {max_team_size} members.

Please enter your *Team Name*:
ask_teammate:
Enter *Teammate {num}* Name & Roll Number (e.g. Jane Doe | 21CS099)
or reply *SKIP* if you have no more teammates:
ask_mentor_name: Please enter your *Faculty Mentor / Advisor Name* for On-Duty (OD) verification:
ask_mentor_phone: Please enter your Mentor/Faculty's *10-digit WhatsApp Phone Number* (e.g. 9876543210):
invalid_phone: ⚠️ Invalid mobile number. Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian WhatsApp number.
self_mentor_error: ⚠️ You cannot enter your own phone number as your Mentor's contact. Please enter your actual Mentor's WhatsApp number.
generating_pass: Generating your official entry pass... Please wait.
mentor_alert:
🏛️ *{fest_name} — OD Verification Request*

Respected Prof. *{mentor_name}*,

Your ward *{student_name}* (Roll: *{reg_no}*, Dept: {dept}) has registered for *{event_name}* at {fest_name}.

To review On-Duty (OD) approval, please reply directly with:
👉 *YES ALL* to approve all pending wards at once
👉 *YES {reg_no}* to approve selectively
👉 *NO {reg_no}* to reject OD

Thank you,
{fest_name} Organizing Committee
mentor_ack_approved: ✅ Thank you! OD permission for *{student_name}* ({reg_no}) has been *APPROVED*.
student_od_approved: 🎉 *Great news, {student_name}!* Your faculty mentor has *APPROVED* your On-Duty (OD) request for *{event_name}*.
student_od_rejected: ⚠️ *Notice:* Your mentor has *REJECTED* the OD request for *{event_name}*. Please reach out to your department coordinator.
payment_prompt:
*Event Registration Fee: INR {fee}*

*UPI Payment Details:*
• VPA / UPI ID: *{upi_id}*
• Payee: *{payee_name}*
• Amount: *INR {fee}*
• Remark / Note: *{reg_no}*

*Direct UPI Link:* {upi_uri}

After completing the payment, *reply with your payment screenshot* to verify the transaction.
payment_duplicate:
⚠️ *Payment Verification Failed*
UTR *{utr_number}* has already been recorded for another registration.
If you believe this is an error, please contact the helpdesk at {upi_id}.
ocr_notice:
*OCR Verification Notice*
Could not clearly detect a 12-digit UPI UTR number from the image.

Please type your *12-digit UTR / Transaction Reference Number* manually:
external_od_choice:
*Faculty OD Intimation*
Would you like an official participation intimation sent to your college faculty/mentor via WhatsApp for On-Duty (OD) records?

Reply:
*1* — YES
*2* — NO
faculty_intimation_dispatched: ✅ Official participation notice has been dispatched to your faculty (*{mentor_name}*).
group_invite:
Join the official participant group for updates and announcements:
{group_link}
spot_syntax_error:
⚠️ *Invalid #SPOT Command Syntax*

Usage format:
*#SPOT Name | College | Dept | RollNo | EventID | Mode*

Example:
*#SPOT Arun Kumar | SVCE | CSE | 21CS045 | CODE_RELAY | CASH*
spot_unauthorized:
⛔ *Access Denied*
Your phone number is not authorized for Spot Registration Desk mode.
session_cancelled: Session cancelled. Type *REGISTER* to start again or *HELP* for assistance.
session_default_help: Type *REGISTER* to begin registration or *STATUS* to check your current registration details.
duplicate_roll_error:
⚠️ Roll Number *{reg_no}* is already registered for *{event_name}* (Status: *{od_status}*).

Type *STATUS* to retrieve your pass.
generic_snag_error: ⚠️ We hit a temporary snag processing your request. Please try again or visit the helpdesk.
payment_invoice_delegate:
💳 *Registration Invoice for {event_name}*

👤 *Participant:* {student_name}
🆔 *Unique Delegate Code:* *{delegate_id}*
💵 *Registration Fee:* *INR {fee}*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📲 *TAP TO PAY (Code Pre-Embedded):*
{upi_link}

👉 *Your code ({delegate_id}) is automatically embedded in the payment link!*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

*Manual Payment Details (if app does not open):*
• *UPI ID:* `{upi_id}`
• *Payee:* {payee_name}
• *Amount:* INR {fee}
• *Mandatory Note / Remarks:* `{delegate_id}`

Once payment is complete, *type your 12-digit UPI UTR / Transaction ID* below:
ask_receipt_screenshot:
✅ UTR *{manual_utr}* recorded!

📸 *Screenshot Mandatory:*
Now, please send the *Payment Screenshot* here.
Make sure the image clearly shows:
1. The 12-digit UTR ({manual_utr})
2. The Note: *{delegate_id}*
invalid_manual_utr: ❌ Invalid UTR. Please enter the exact *12-digit numeric UPI Ref / UTR number* from your payment receipt:
fraud_note_missing:
⚠️ *Transaction Note Missing:*
The screenshot does not show your Unique Code (*{delegate_id}*) in the transaction remarks/notes. Please upload a full screenshot clearly showing the transaction note.
